# Leave and Accommodation Policy 2026

## FMLA Eligibility

Employees are eligible for FMLA leave only after 12 months of employment and
1,250 hours worked in the prior 12 months.

## Medical Accommodation Path

Employees who are not yet FMLA eligible may still request a temporary medical
accommodation through HR review.

## Medical Certification

HR may request medical certification and must give the employee 15 calendar days
to return it unless impracticable.
